paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh tapate na hi ua; misi ziak in na ki-atkeh ding uh ahi kei. Na mitmul uh leng na metmai ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
heading: Phal Louh Kisunna Dan

paite: TOUPA na Pathian a ding in nam siangthou na hi uh. Leitung a nam tengteng tung ah amah a tuam mawng hi dia TOUPA'N hon tel na hi uhi.
Thilkihhuai himhim na ne ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Sa Siang Leh Siang Lou / (Lev 11.1-47)

paite: Hiai sate ahi, na nek theih ding uh: Bawngtal, belam, kel,
sakhi, sangai, sakhital, sathak, gamkel, gamlawi leh gam belam.
Sa chiteng, achin ka, achin ka paisuak, eknel hai chi peuhmah na ne thei ding uh.
Himahleh eknel hai lel leh achin uh leng ka ngalte, na nek ding uh ahi kei. Sangawngsau, zupi leh zusapi in eknel ahai na ua, achin uh akat louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh.
Vok ahihleh achin aka na a, eknel ahai louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi; asa na ne ding uh ahi kei a, asiluang leng na khoih ding uh ahi kei.
Tui a tengte lak ah hiaite na ne thei ding uh: phe leh lip nei peuhmah na ne thei ding uhi.
Phe leh lip nei lou peuhmahte na ne thei kei ding uh, nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh.
Vasa siang tengteng na ne thei ding uh.
Hiaite zaw na ne ding uh ahi kei: Muvanlai, mungawnggiau, mu-akla;
musane, mumeika, mu chi himhim;
va-ak chi himhim;
simbu, zan mu, mu chi himhim, tuipi mu;
simbu neu, simbu lian, simbutanglip;
gamdai simbu, musane, vangawngsau;
Tuiva kengsang, tuivapi chi himhim, huihtun leh bak.
Kha nei khe a pai chi himhim nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh, nek ding ahi kei.
Vasa siang tengteng na ne thei ding uh.

Amah sih a si bangmah na nek ding uh ahi kei. Na ompih uh gamdang mite nek ding in na pe thei ding uh. Namdang mite kiang ah leng na zuak thei ding uh. Nou zaw TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in nam siangthou na hi uhi. Kelnou api nawitui in na huan ding uh ahi kei.
Kum chih in na lou ua an tung tengteng sawm-a-khat na piak ngeingei ding uh ahi.

TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siamna dan na hon theihgige theihna ding un sawm-a-khat, na buh uh, na uain uh, na thau uh leh na ganhon uh leh na belamhon lak ua piang masapente TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, amin omna dia aseh ding ah na ne ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl chiang in, TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding mun agamlat luat ziak a nou a dia alampi asau luat a, na tawi theih kei uleh,
sum na suah ding ua, sum na tawi ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un amun sehna ah na hoh ding uh ahi.

Na lungsim ua na deihpen uh, bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, uain hiam, zu khauh hiam, na lungsim ua na lunggulh peuhmah uh a ding in sum na zang ding ua; huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na ne ding ua, kipaktak in na om ding uh; noute leh na inkote uh toh.
Na tenna ua teng Levite limsak lou in om het kei un. Na lak uah amau tantuan leh goutan anei kei uhi.
heading: Sawm-a-khat Piakdan

paite: Kum thum achin kum in huai kum a na thil tung tengteng ua sawm-a-khat na lakhawm vek ding ua, na omna uah na koih ding uh ahi.

Na omna ua om Levite leng, na lak ua tantuan, goutan leng neiloute leh gamdang mite leh pa neiloute leh meithaite'n ane ding ua, ahong khosa thei sam ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut koihna teng uh avualzawl ding hi.
